evidence_type: real checkpoint inference on saved RGB/proprio, not simulated policy success

request.instruction: Approach the block and align the gripper. Lower the gripper to the grasp pose. Close the gripper on the block. Lift the block. Move the block toward the destination while reorienting it. Lower the block into the target region. Open the gripper to release the block. Move the gripper away from the placed block.

config.history_contract: Actual causal robot RGB, native saved-frame rate; paired cameras, chronological timestamps. Per-camera frame native vision features mean-pooled; explicit time/camera encoding; history vision branch no-grad; exact per-frame feature cache only for M3/M4 whose entire vision encoder remains frozen; M5/M6 recompute each step. Capacity compression pools adjacent encoded tokens without dropping source images.
config.initialization: Pinned fresh base; isolated row29 copied from pretrained domain3 or freshly reset, as explicitly configured. No old fine-tuned weights unless init_checkpoint is declared.
config.paper_distinction: Explicit warmup/ramp/joint counts; smoke counts do not reproduce the1000/1000/1000paper-scale schedule.

annotation_conditioning.experiment: explicit privileged annotation-conditioned training, not image-only deployed capability
annotation_conditioning.held_sidecar: held_value*valid and validity, UNKNOWN remains0/false; no grasp action label is invented

config.requested_conditioning: Training demonstration supplies requested semantic scope/instruction/duration/timestamp schedule as conditional-task labels. Inference must provide user/planner/policy requests, never future held-out labels.
config.padding: Remove invalid tokens before native attention/noise. Select semantic_mask tokens before native action-space reductions. Context prefix is real evidence but not a supervised semantic action.
config.decoding: Timestamped waypoints only. No consecutive20Hz replay of sparse anchors; timed controller remains outside this smoke.
config.data_exclusions: Frozen validation/test/failed/excluded source takes excluded. Only declared training catalog rows participate, including explicit R/S/C training assignments. Geometric parity replays are not extra diversity.

load_info.history_adapter: fixed timestamp/camera encoding; same native feature weights and append_causal_history as training
